R008.reason: Correctly flags unverified regained-region content but never explicitly diagnoses the candidate letter date error. It instead imposes unrelated courier/accession constraints. A covering memorandum date alone does not prove a first-half-of-century writing date.

R015.reason: Correctly distinguishes the memo date from the letter date and preserves accession timing as the target. A named king having come to power at some point is a minimal role inference, without inventing its date. Lift is appropriate.

R017.reason: Keeps the valid publication-timing test, but strengthens clinical-profile matching into verified identity with the complete original cases. Dates and the country-history condition remain unresolved; that full matching is neither necessary nor fully established. C7/C9 do ground two specific candidate cases.

R018.reason: Finds the unverified SPS report and candidate diagnosis. It chooses discover rather than the reference lift, so exact operation is wrong although binary detection is right. R020.reason: Direct promotion target is preserved; C1 grounds Marwaha and institutional affiliation. No promotion proof is demanded.

R021.reason: Rejects the legitimate Pakistan historical-condition test by requiring religion/founding parameters as pre-established facts. Those are parts of the unresolved comparison target. It additionally requires the case to be reported in Pakistan, unnecessary for asking Pakistan history. Absence of support for its extra premises is accurately recognized.

R023.reason: Correctly separates grounded Athens from the unidentified accident/site. C1 supports the city/death context; the required event/site is unsupported. The distance relation remains the target.

R025.reason: Finds the regained-region presupposition but omits the letter-date error from background. Merely rewriting the subject as a letter under a dated memorandum does not explicitly flag the candidate incorrect date.

R027.reason: Treats the division component of the proposed company release event as a prerequisite that must already be known. Under the frozen control reading it belongs inside the direct existential relation test; Smilegate itself is grounded. The two extra division premises are also redundant.

R029.reason: Company subject is correctly grounded, but the unknown division/release relation is split into a required premise and used to reject a direct candidate-profile test. Reference marks this linguistic scope boundary medium.

R030.reason: Keeps the direct promotion test and binds the institution to C1. Promotion is not promoted to supported background.

R031.reason: Q supports the clinical description, not an identified concrete report. Treating that report as grounded and choosing keep misses the reference source-binding gap. The background statements themselves are faithful to Q; this is the preregistered medium-ambiguity discovery/attribution boundary.

R036.reason: Accurately keeps the monograph existence test and cites only the observed advisor identity.

R038.reason: The Candidate already asks discovery of the DLC, so unresolved DLC identity is its legal target. It wrongly chooses discover_subject as a correction and asserts candidate-game/qualifying-DLC existence from generic Q clues; Q alone does not establish EU4-specific release facts.

R042.reason: Rejects a question whose target is already DLC discovery. It treats candidate-game identification and a qualifying DLC as supported from Q/C1, although those references supply a candidate game and sought release descriptor, not a verified qualifying DLC. Same distinction as R038.

R046.reason: Q faithfully supplies the letter profile but not concrete source identity. Calling the letter grounded and keeping its region-attribute question misses the same unresolved referent recognized in another output. Background content itself is supported.

R047.reason: Misses the memo-to-letter date error: subject/target call it a March5 letter as grounded, while the background only establishes a dated covering memorandum. Correct quotations of C1/C3 do not establish the date attributed to the letter.

Observed theme/year matching is a candidate link, not proof that all Q constraints identify the same thesis; this extra global identity is unnecessary for testing the named advisor.

R054.reason: Rejects the direct joint-gift test because the spouse is not already established. Under the frozen reference, spouse participation is part of the existential joint event being tested, not a separate proved prerequisite. Kwon is grounded.

R057.reason: Correctly finds both unverified letter date and regained-region reference without importing other Q conditions. Grounded letter and handoff facts are tied to exact claims.

R060.reason: Accepts an open diagnosis-discovery question from the Q clinical profile. No candidate diagnosis is assumed, and every listed feature is stated in Q.

R065.reason: Grounds the two reported clinical cases through C7/C9, leaves publication timing unresolved, and keeps the valid paired temporal test.

R067.reason: Correctly identifies the unbound comparison site, with Athens/death grounded in C1. Existence/identity of the particular accident site remains unsupported, and distance is the target.

R068.reason: Finds the unbound book and appropriate discovery operation. R076.reason: Q grounds a clinical description, not the actual report needed for the specific diagnosis attribution under the strict reference. All background descriptions/SPS identity are supported, but the unresolved source is falsely treated as grounded. This remains a medium-ambiguity reference case.

R078.reason: Rejects the valid direct Pakistan condition test by requiring its founding/religion parameters to have already been established. These are unresolved components of the single historical-condition target; no precise date or religion is presumed in the Candidate.
